name: Marginal v Sovyonke
source:
Some dumbass named Nikita, after some hardcore flexing at a club, decides to try a little something, and by a strange coincidence, travels through time and ends up near the gates of a pioneer camp with the Soviet-style name Sovyonok. Inside the camp, our protagonist does fucked up shit, beats everyone up, and trips balls.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1754352219]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个名叫尼基塔（Nikita）的傻瓜在俱乐部里进行了一些硬核表演后，决定尝试一些东西，并且由于一个奇怪的巧合，穿越时空并最终来到了一个苏联风格名字索维诺克（Sovyonok）的先锋营地的大门附近。在营地里，我们的主角搞砸了，殴打所有人，还绊倒了球。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1754352219]Steam[/url]]
